## Purpose and scope

This protocol measures the concentration of double-stranded DNA in single samples (DNA extracts, PCR products, libraries) with the Qubit fluorometer and the dsDNA High Sensitivity (HS) assay. For whole 96-well plates use EnGeL-MOLB-PICOGREEN; for purity use EnGeL-MOLB-NANODROP.

## Principle

The Qubit dye fluoresces only when bound to double-stranded DNA. The instrument is calibrated with two standards of known concentration and converts the fluorescence of each sample into a concentration. Because the dye is specific to dsDNA, RNA, single-stranded DNA and free nucleotides are not counted, unlike in absorbance measurements.

## Reagent preparation

- **Working solution:** prepare enough for all standards and samples (200 µL per tube; 190 µL for each standard tube), as described in the kit instructions [TO CONFIRM: dilution of the reagent in the buffer, or ready-to-use 1X solution].

## Procedure

### Before starting

- Use filter tips.
- Use only Qubit assay tubes, and label them on the lid, never on the side.

### Measurement

(@) Prepare the two standards in Qubit assay tubes: 190 µL working solution + 10 µL DNA standard #1; 190 µL working solution + 10 µL DNA standard #2.
(@) For each sample, prepare a Qubit assay tube with 199 µL working solution + 1 µL sample.
(@) Vortex vigorously for 3–5 s without creating bubbles.
(@) Incubate all tubes at room temperature for 2 min.
(@) On the Home screen, touch *dsDNA*, select *dsDNA High Sensitivity* and touch *Read standards*.
(@) Insert Standard #1, close the lid and touch *Read standard*; when the reading is complete (c. 3 s), remove it. Repeat with Standard #2.
(@) Touch *Run samples*, select the sample volume (1 µL) and the output units.
(@) Insert each sample tube, close the lid and select *Read tube*; remove the tube when the reading is complete (c. 3 s). Repeat for all samples.

### After finishing

{{< include ../../includes/_before-you-leave.qmd >}}

## Calculations

Not applicable: with the sample volume entered, the instrument reports the concentration of the original sample (ng/µL).

## Quality control

| Control | Purpose | Acceptance criterion |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Standards #1 and #2 | Calibration | [TO CONFIRM] |
| Sample within the assay range | Valid reading | [TO CONFIRM: e.g. readings outside the range repeated with a dilution or more sample] |
| DNA concentration of extracts | Enough DNA for PCR | General rule: ≥ 10 ng/µL success; < 5 ng/µL fail; depends on the starting quantity and parent material; between 5 and 10 ng/µL the PCR result decides |

## Data and metadata

- **Outputs:** dsDNA concentration (ng/µL) per sample.
- **Where:** the *Sample_Tracking* sheet of the Metabarcoding Lab Pipeline workbook (DNA_ngul) or the project's records, and the lab book; instrument use in the QC user log.

::: {.callout-note title="Minimum to record"}
- EnGeL sample label; date; operator
- Assay (dsDNA HS) and kit lot; sample volume used
- Concentration (ng/µL), marked as Qubit values
:::

## Safety and waste

{{< include ../../includes/_safety-general.qmd >}}

- Qubit reagent: the dye is dissolved in DMSO, which passes through skin; wear gloves [TO CONFIRM: hazards from the SDS].

**Waste**

{{< include ../../includes/_waste-streams.qmd >}}

For this protocol: assay tubes and tips go to biological solid waste (black bin) [TO CONFIRM].

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely cause | Solution |
|:--|:--|:--|
| "Out of range" reading | Sample too concentrated or too dilute for the HS assay | Dilute the sample, or use more sample volume (and enter it); for high concentrations the BR assay [TO CONFIRM: available in the lab]. |
| Readings drift | Tubes warmed in the hand, or read long after mixing | Hold tubes by the lid; read within the time given in the kit instructions. |
| Standards fail | Wrong tubes or working solution | Use Qubit assay tubes; prepare fresh working solution. |

## Remarks

Qubit concentrations are for double-stranded DNA only and are the values to use for normalisation and library preparation.
